RENDERING_RULES_AND_NEGATIVE_PROMPT_INST: Render only the exact_* text values.
All container fills are pure white; borders carry the palette.
Use only structural rectangles, grid lines, simple connectors and text.
No pictograms, illustrations, photographs, logos, maps or decorative assets.
No experimental values, trends, performance curves or significance markers.
Main data flow is solid; optional or return flow is dashed.
Keep all content inside a generous safe margin; use clear Chinese labels.
No figure ID and no overall title inside the canvas.
